notes: Example plan in free mode: H3 generates picture and sound. Two images (robot, workshop) in examples/; a voice sample named 'robot' is optional.

pictures.role: orange body, dark visor face with two round glowing blue eyes and a thin blue light for a mouth, yellow-bulb antenna, blue ear bolts and chest panel with three coloured buttons

workshop.description: The workshop, its workbench, pegboard of tools, window and wooden crates

clips.name: fixing_lamp

dialogue.speaker: robot
dialogue.text: Oh, hello! You're just in time.

clips.summary: In a cosy workshop, the little robot is repairing a desk lamp at the workbench; it notices the camera and greets it.
clips.description:
The target video is a colourful stylized 3D animated short in the style of a family animated film, with soft toy-like materials, clean shapes and colours matching the references, gentle physically grounded camera movement, no on-screen text.
[Shot 1] Medium shot in the workshop, warm daylight from the window. @robot stands at the workbench with its back half turned, tightening a screw on a small desk lamp with a screwdriver. It pauses, turns its head toward the camera, its eyes light up and it waves the screwdriver. @robot (S), cheerful and a little surprised, says: <d>[English] Oh, hello! You're just in time.</d> Its mouth light flickers with each word. End with the robot turning back to the lamp, reaching for its switch, the movement still in progress. Setting: @workshop.
clips.soundscape: Quiet workshop room tone, the squeak of the screwdriver, a soft whirr of the robot's motors, birds faintly outside the window.

clips.name: lamp_works

dialogue.speaker: robot
dialogue.text: Look, it works! Want to build something together?

clips.summary: Same unbroken shot: the robot switches the repaired lamp on, it glows, and the robot invites the viewer to build something together.
clips.description:
The target video is a colourful stylized 3D animated short in the style of a family animated film, with soft toy-like materials, clean shapes and colours matching the references, gentle physically grounded camera movement, no on-screen text.
[Shot 1] @robot presses the lamp's switch with a click; the lamp lights up with a warm yellow glow. The robot claps its hands once, turns back to the camera and spreads its arms. @robot (S), delighted, says: <d>[English] Look, it works! Want to build something together?</d> It tilts its head, waiting for an answer. End with a quiet half second, mouth light still. Setting: @workshop.
clips.soundscape: The click of the switch, a faint electric hum from the lamp, the robot's soft motor whirr, quiet room tone.
